description: This Java source file defines the RenderedImage class, which manages rendering, scaling, and decoration (such as shadows and device frames) for images used in Android layout previews within the IDE. It includes methods for zooming, painting, and handling device-specific rendering details.

classes.name: RenderedImage
classes.description: A class that manages rendering, scaling, and decoration of images for Android layout previews, including support for shadows, device frames, and retina display handling.

classes.name: ShadowType
classes.description: An enum defining types of shadows that can be applied to the rendered image: NONE, RECTANGULAR, ARBITRARY.

methods.name: hasAlphaChannel
methods.description: Returns whether the image has an alpha channel.

methods.name: hasDropShadow
methods.description: Determines if the image should be painted with a drop shadow based on the shadow type.

methods.name: getScale
methods.description: Returns the current scale factor of the image.

methods.name: setScale
methods.description: Sets the scale factor for the image, adjusting for maximum size constraints and normalizing near 1.0.

methods.name: getImageBounds
methods.description: Calculates and returns the bounds of the image including device frame if applicable.

methods.name: zoomToFit
methods.description: Adjusts the scale to fit the image within available dimensions, respecting margins and zoom constraints.

methods.name: zoomIn
methods.description: Zooms into the image by a fixed factor.

methods.name: zoomOut
methods.description: Zooms out of the image by a fixed factor.

methods.name: zoomActual
methods.description: Resets the zoom to actual size, with Retina considerations on Mac.

methods.name: getOriginalImage
methods.description: Returns the original full-size BufferedImage.

methods.name: getOriginalWidth
methods.description: Returns the original width of the image.

methods.name: getOriginalHeight
methods.description: Returns the original height of the image.

methods.name: getScaledWidth
methods.description: Returns the width of the image scaled by the current scale factor.

methods.name: getScaledHeight
methods.description: Returns the height of the image scaled by the current scale factor.

methods.name: getScaledSize
methods.description: Returns the scaled size as a Dimension object.

methods.name: getRequiredWidth
methods.description: Calculates the width needed to display the image including device frame and shadows.

methods.name: getRequiredHeight
methods.description: Calculates the height needed to display the image including device frame and shadows.

methods.name: getRequiredSize
methods.description: Returns the total size needed to display the image with decorations.

methods.name: paint
methods.description: Paints the image onto a Graphics context at specified coordinates, handling scaling, shadows, device frames, and retina display.

methods.name: paintRetina
methods.description: Specialized painting method for Retina displays, handling pixel doubling and retina-specific effects.

methods.name: setMaxSize
methods.description: Sets maximum width and height constraints for the image.

methods.name: getMaxWidth
methods.description: Returns the maximum width constraint.

methods.name: getMaxHeight
methods.description: Returns the maximum height constraint.

methods.name: setUseLargeShadows
methods.description: Configures whether to use large or small shadows.

methods.name: setDeviceFrameEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables device frame rendering.

methods.name: isFramed
methods.description: Indicates whether the current image has a device frame.

methods.name: getShowDropShadow
methods.description: Returns whether drop shadow is enabled.

methods.name: imageChanged
methods.description: Invalidates the scaled image cache when the source image changes.

methods.name: getClip
methods.description: Creates a clipping shape (ellipse for round devices) for rendering.

methods.name: paintClipped
methods.description: Paints an image into a Graphics2D context with optional clipping for device shapes.
